full_prompt_en: A square painted sculptural relief presents a crowded group of townspeople standing above a toy-like railway and miniature street, all surrounded by a thick irregular border of foliage and small found-looking forms. The scene sits against a plain light background, so the relief's raised outer edge is easy to see. Across the upper middle, a row of adults in differently colored jackets, hats, and trousers stands shoulder to shoulder beneath a patch of blue sky. Some faces turn toward one another, while others look outward, making the group feel animated without a single dominant gesture. A few smaller figures occupy the left side and the lower ledge. The supporting platform angles across the center, creating a strong shelf between the full-size figures and the tiny world beneath them. At the lower left, a dark miniature locomotive with reddish cars curves along a track. On the right below the platform, compressed buildings, a waterway, small boats, and clustered streets are packed into a shallow space. Green, ocher, orange, blue, and brick red are applied in many small, uneven areas, with visible hand-modeled ridges and painted crevices. Details are intentionally exaggerated in scale, from faces and hats to train windows and little rooftops. Broad, even front light catches the raised surfaces, while dark pockets in the recesses make the layers feel physically deep. The overall composition is boisterous and densely stacked, joining theatrical human figures with a miniature city in one tactile, playful tableau.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形彩绘雕塑浮雕呈现一群拥挤的市民站在玩具般的小铁路和微型街道上方，周围围着由叶丛和似拾得物的小形态组成的厚重不规则边框。作品置于素净浅色背景前，因此凸起的外缘清楚可见。上部中央一排成年人穿着颜色各异的外套、帽子和裤子，肩并肩站在一小片蓝天下。有些面容转向彼此，另一些看向外侧，使人群充满动感，却没有单一主导动作。几个较小人物处于左侧和下方平台。承托的平台斜跨中央，在大比例人物与下方微小世界之间形成一道强烈隔层。左下角一辆深色微型蒸汽火车带着红褐色车厢沿铁轨转弯。平台下方右侧，压缩的房屋、水道、小船和簇集街道挤在浅空间内。绿色、赭黄、橙、蓝和砖红被涂成许多细小不匀的区域，可见手工塑出的凸脊和涂色凹缝。从面孔、帽子到火车窗和小屋顶，细节的尺度有意夸张。宽泛均匀的正面光照亮凸起表面，凹处深暗的小区域让层次显得确实有厚度。整体构图热闹而密集叠置，把戏剧化人群和微型城市结合成可触而俏皮的场面。
style_prompt_en: The image has a hand-built, painted-relief finish that combines miniature detail with deliberately exaggerated scale. Raised ridges catch light and deep crevices hold shadow, so texture and physical depth remain visible even in the busiest passages. Green, ocher, brick red, orange, and blue appear in many small uneven patches rather than smooth gradients. Compact clusters of tiny marks gather beneath larger upright shapes, creating a tiered, almost theatrical rhythm. Contours are lumpy and animated, with crisp painted accents sitting on rough modeled surfaces. Broad frontal illumination clarifies the layered construction while leaving dark pockets between overlaps. A crowded interior is balanced by an irregular but clearly bounded outer silhouette. The overall effect is exuberant, tactile, and playfully chaotic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有手工搭建并彩绘的浮雕质感，把微型细节与有意夸张的尺度结合。凸脊接住光线，深缝留住阴影，因此即使在最繁忙的区域，肌理和实体深度依然可见。绿、赭黄、砖红、橙和蓝以许多细小不均的色斑出现，而非平滑渐层。紧凑的微小笔画聚在较大直立形态之下，建立分层而近乎舞台式的节奏。轮廓起伏而活跃，清楚的涂色强调落在粗糙塑形表面上。宽泛正面光理清层叠结构，在重叠处之间留下深色小空隙。拥挤的内部由不规则却清楚限定的外部剪影平衡。整体效果欢腾、可触且俏皮地杂乱。
theme_en: A crowded painted relief of townspeople above a toy-like railway
theme_zh: 小火车上方聚集市民的彩绘浮雕
name: Red Grooms
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
